an7.55:1.1: satta ca bhikkhave purisagatiyo desessāmi anupādā ca parinibbānaṃ
an7.55:1.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an7.55:2.1: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ paṭipanno hoti
an7.55:2.2: no cassa no ca me siyā na bhavissati na me bhavissati yadatthi yaṃ bhūtaṃ taṃ pajahāmīti upekkhaṃ paṭilabhati
an7.55:2.3: so bhave na rajjati sambhave na sajjati atthuttari padaṃ santaṃ sammappaññāya passati
an7.55:2.4: tañca khvassa padaṃ na sabbena sabbaṃ sacchikataṃ hoti tassa na sabbena sabbaṃ mānānusayo pahīno hoti na sabbena sabbaṃ bhavarāgānusayo pahīno hoti na sabbena sabbaṃ avijjānusayo pahīno hoti
an7.55:2.5: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti
an7.55:2.6: seyyathāpi bhikkhave divasasantatte ayokapāle haññamāne pappaṭikā nibbattitvā nibbāyeyya
an7.55:2.7: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ paṭipanno hoti
